database_server.isolation_strategy: Isolated Database and unique non-root DB User per tenant

engine_optimization_rules.rationale: High read performance, zero foreign key overhead, significantly lower RAM consumption.

engine_optimization_rules.client_type: Transactional / Financial / Office Systems (E-Procurement, Koperasi, Asuransi)
engine_optimization_rules.rationale: Strict ACID compliance, Row-Level Locking, strict Foreign Key data integrity validation.

swap_memory.purpose: Prevent Out-of-Memory (OOM) crashes during concurrent spikes from multi-tenant traffic.

os_level_optimization.backup_strategy: Automated disk snapshots via GCP Persistent Disk configuration.

core_system.name: E-Procurement RKZ
core_system.engine: InnoDB (migratable to MyISAM via ALTER ENGINE if requested by enterprise stakeholders)

deployment_steps_blueprint: Step 1: Provision e2-medium instance with Ubuntu Server on Google Compute Engine.
Step 2: Assign a Static External IP Address to the instance.
Step 3: Update DNS A-Records on client registrars (Hostinger, etc.) pointing '@' to the Static IP.
Step 4: Install LAMP Stack (Apache, MySQL, PHP) via terminal.
Step 5: Create isolated directories in /var/www/ and databases in MySQL with unique users.
Step 6: Configure Apache Virtual Host files (.conf) for each domain in /etc/apache2/sites-available/.
Step 7: Enable sites via 'a2ensite' and reload Apache.
Step 8: Execute Certbot to automatically apply and configure SSL certificates across all active domains.
